items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: I liked it and went to Mr. Vic and gave me a few lessons.

ctx.x: They were one of the best bands in the South. They must have been very good bands. How come you took up trombone? How did you happen to pick that? Well, I saw it and I saw one in the showcase and bought it.
I liked it and went to Mr. Vic and gave me a few lessons. I used to be with Sonny. Sonny Henry though, my little boy. Yeah. My little fellow, Sonny Henry.

He'd take me over a while and I went back to Mr. Vic. We had a couple of good interviews with Sonny Henry before he died last year. Yes. I'm still wondering if there's anything else you can tell us about Vic Gaspar. How much did he charge for lessons about? Well, lessons, well he used to only charge 50 cents a lesson. 50 cents a lesson. In them days, you know. Of course, in those days it was a good deal of money too. Good deal of money. Oh, I mean. That's the 25th. That's a good deal of money, right. Right. How…
